html:
Fixed

  • 2027 Atlas showed the wrong A/C refrigerant amount. When two Atlas versions share one table (Sales Code DH1 vs DJ1), the Fluids window was listing *both* — so a DJ1 Atlas also saw the DH1 charge. It now shows only the rows for the scanned vehicle’s Sales Code (plus any that apply to both). If the Sales Code is blank or doesn’t match, it still shows everything so nothing is hidden. (#183.)
